canonical_project: Shanghai LinkWise Surxondaryo 300 MW data center
owner: Shanghai LinkWise Data Intelligence Co., Ltd.
notes: Uzbekistan's Ministry of Energy signed an MoU with Chinese firm Shanghai LinkWise Data Intelligence on 24 July 2025 for a 300 MW data center in Bukhara region, with a similar 300 MW facility planned for Surkhandarya (Surxondaryo) region (combined 600 MW program, per Ministry of Energy statements); Baxtel lists 'LinkWise: Surxondaryo' as planned for 2029. No exact site within the region or construction start announced.
